trigger_condition: Queue file has a torn/truncated JSONL line (killed hook mid-append); readJSONL throws on JSON.parse
potential_consequence: Transform returns success:false every run; no new turns queued, pointer never advances

trigger_condition: Existing record with same payloadId is terminal failed (syncAttempts >= MAX_CONVERSATION_SYNC_ATTEMPTS)
potential_consequence: Re-transformed turn is skipped forever; exhausted turn can never be re-queued or synced

trigger_condition: Newer covering candidate later exhausts retries and stays terminal failed
guard_snippet: on terminal failure of a record, revert records it superseded (track supersededBy payloadId) back to pending
potential_consequence: Older record's content is never sent; superseded is terminal with no revival path

trigger_condition: Batch contains several records sharing one payloadId; duplicates skipped via continue
potential_consequence: Result reports e.g. Synced 1/2 although every payload succeeded
